definitions.explanation: Belief in one's own abilities, qualities, or judgment.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{自信|じしん}に{満|み}ちている。
{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}して{自信|じしん}がついた。
examples.english: I gained confidence after passing the exam.

notes:
{自信|じしん} refers to confidence in oneself and one's abilities.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {自信|じしん}がある: to have confidence
- {自信|じしん}がない: to lack confidence
- {自信|じしん}を{持|も}つ: to have confidence
- {自信|じしん}がつく: to gain confidence
- {自信|じしん}を{失|うしな}う: to lose confidence
- {自信|じしん}に{満|み}ちた: full of confidence
- {自信|じしん}{過剰|かじょう}: overconfidence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {確信|かくしん}: conviction, firm belief (about something external)
- {信頼|しんらい}: trust (in others)
